name: Kyoto Slow-Drip Cold Brew
description: 12-hour cold atmospheric extraction using Colombian Geisha micro-lot. Notes of candied orange, dark cacao, and jasmine blossom.

name: Oat Velvet Cortado
description: Equal parts double ristretto espresso and textured minor figures oat milk, served in hand-thrown ceramic tumbler.

name: Ethiopian Guji Pour-Over
description: V60 pour-over showcasing heirloom natural process beans with wild blueberry, bergamot, and honey sweetness.

name: Ceremonial Uji Matcha Latte
description: First harvest stone-ground green tea from Kyoto whisked with steamed almond milk and raw wildflower blossom nectar.

name: Sparkling Cascara Tonic
description: Brewed sun-dried coffee fruit skin infused with Meyer lemon, fresh rosemary sprig, and handcrafted sparkling tonic water.

name: Heirloom Avocado Tartine
description: Toasted house sourdough, smashed Hass avocados, pickled shallots, Persian feta, toasted dukkah spice, and micro cilantro.

name: Smoked Salmon Brioche Benedict
description: Wild Pacific king salmon, 64° poached farm eggs, caper emulsion, and tarragon hollandaise over butter toasted brioche.

name: Pistachio Rose Cardamom Danish
description: 36-layer laminated French butter pastry filled with roasted pistachio frangipane, dried Damask rose petals, and cardamom glaze.

name: Brown Butter Canelé
description: Traditional Bordeaux pastry baked in copper molds with caramelized beeswax crust and custardy vanilla bean heart.
